title: A Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Thermal Ranking of Low-Cost Wall Materials in Hot-Dry Climates: Source Code and Data
description:
Source code, data and trained models for the manuscript: Khan, M. A., Raees, F. and Fatima, U. "A Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Thermal Ranking of Low-Cost Wall Materials in Hot-Dry Climates" (Scientific Reports, under review). Version 1.2.0 corresponds to the revised manuscript and reproduces all its results, tables and figures.

Contents. notebooks/fdm_solver_diurnal.ipynb (run first; CPU, about 30 min): Crank-Nicolson FDM with diurnal Robin forcing, validations, 1500-sample LHS dataset and material ranking; exact periodic (frequency-domain) solution used for verification, solver timing, ISO 13786 quantities, Monte Carlo rank reversal, exact climate maps, indoor-temperature dependence, longwave sky exchange, Sobol' indices and cost sensitivity. notebooks/pino_diurnal.ipynb (T4 GPU, about 20 min with the provided models): FNO and PINO evaluation, multi-seed data-efficiency and lambda studies, figures, inference timing and comparison with the exact solution. data/: dataset and NASA POWER forcing verification package. models/: representative FNO and PINO (median seed). results/: all result tables. figures/: all figures (PNG and PDF).

Changes from v1.1.0. Analyses added for the peer-review revision; notebooks reorganised so that the FDM notebook runs first and the PINO notebook second; trained models added.
